name: case_read_tool
purpose: Read authorized de-identified case summaries for training or approved internal analysis.
permission_boundary: Only de-identified training records may be returned. No personal identifiers.
failure_behavior: Return permission_denied or no_records_found with reason.

name: schema_validator
purpose: Validate structured case records against a predefined schema.
permission_boundary: Does not infer missing facts; only validates provided fields.
failure_behavior: Return validation_error with field path and expected type.

name: official_site_fetcher
purpose: Fetch public official announcements from approved domains.

outputs.results: array of title, date, url, summary

name: web_search
purpose: Search public web sources for current information.

outputs.results: array of title, date, url, snippet

permission_boundary: Public sources only. Do not search internal case systems.

name: source_tracker
purpose: Record source metadata used by an agent.
permission_boundary: Stores metadata only, not sensitive personal data.

name: policy_retriever
purpose: Retrieve relevant SOP snippets from an approved policy knowledge base.

outputs.snippets: array of document_id, version_date, paragraph, text

permission_boundary: Returns only documents the user is authorized to view.

name: audit_logger
purpose: Log tool use, parameters, outputs, and human review status.
permission_boundary: Must not store full sensitive raw data in logs.
failure_behavior: Return log_failed; agent should stop high-risk workflow if logging fails.
